import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb

# Suppress lightgbm progress bars
lgb.set_logger(lgb.Logger(level="ERROR"))


def main():
    train_path = "./input/train.csv"
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    sample_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
    submission_dir = "./submission"
    submission_file = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    df_train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    df_test = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    df_sample = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

    id_col = "Id"
    target_col = "Cover_Type"
    feature_cols = [c for c in df_train.columns if c != id_col and c != target_col]

    X = df_train[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    y_str = df_train[target_col].values
    ids = df_train[id_col].astype(str).values

    X_test = df_test[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    ids_test = df_test[id_col].astype(str).values

    n_samples = len(X)
    indices = np.random.permutation(n_samples)

    val_size = int(n_samples * 0.15)  # 15% held out for validation

    idx_train = indices[:-val_size]
    idx_val = indices[-val_size:]

    X_tr = X[idx_train]
    y_tr = y_str[idx_train]
    ids_tr = ids[idx_train]

    X_va = X[idx_val]
    y_va = y_str[idx_val]

    # Map string labels to 0-indexed contiguous integers
    unique_classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(unique_classes)}
    y_tr_enc = np.array([class_to_idx[c] for c in y_tr], dtype=np.int64)
    y_va_enc = np.array([class_to_idx[c] for c in y_va], dtype=np.int64)

    # Training params for LightGBM multi-class
    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": len(unique_classes),
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
        "max_bin": 255,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "gamma": 0.1,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 15,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
    }

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr_enc, feature_name=feature_cols)
    callbacks = [lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)]

    model = lgb.train(params, train_data, num_boost_round=1000, callbacks=callbacks)

    # Holdout validation predictions
    y_pred_va_raw = model.predict(X_va, num_iteration=model.best_iteration_)
    y_pred_va_labels = np.argmax(y_pred_va_raw, axis=1)
    val_acc = np.mean(y_pred_va_labels == y_va_enc)
    print(f"Validation Multi-Class Classification Accuracy: {val_acc:.6f}")

    # Test predictions
    y_pred_test_raw = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration_)
    y_pred_test_labels = np.argmax(y_pred_test_raw, axis=1)

    # Create submission dataframe
    submissions_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": ids_test, "Cover_Type": y_pred_test_labels})

    # Save submission
    submissions_df.to_csv(submission_file, index=False)
    print("Submission file saved to:", submission_file)
    return val_acc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    score = main()
